query: SELECT order_date, gross_revenue FROM main_marts.mart_daily_revenue WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL 30 DAY
SELECT product_id, feature_date, lag_7_qty, rolling_28_avg, next_day_qty FROM main_marts.mart_demand_features WHERE product_id = 'PRD00001'
SELECT supplier_id, reliability_score, total_units_sold FROM main_marts.mart_supplier_reliability ORDER BY reliability_score ASC LIMIT 10
